papers.title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
papers.brief: 研究让冻结参数的大模型智能体自行设计上下文学习算法：仅提供算力预算、经验采集与文档更新工具及改进目标，不设固定循环，在游戏中自主试验。

papers.what_it_is: 研究让冻结参数的大模型智能体自行设计上下文学习算法：仅提供算力预算、经验采集与文档更新工具及改进目标，不设固定循环，在游戏中自主试验。

papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a basic question: do these increasingly capable models still need us to specify how they should self-improve? In this paper we study an autonomous paradigm in which, given basic primitives, resources, and a general goal for self-improvement, agents construct their own self-learning algorithm for context-based optimization. Using the setting of gameplay as a testbed, a frozen LLM agent is given a compute budget and tools for collecting experience and updating text documents, and allowed to freely experiment without an externally imposed loop or access to real-world data. We find that sufficiently capable models do self-improve under these conditions, demonstrating strategies that align with classic cognitive frameworks for self-regulated learning and constructs from machine learning literature on self-generated curricula. Furthermore, we study the extent to which the learned text artifacts transfer to external benchmarks, observing improvement across different game horizons, mechanics, and 3D navigation.

papers.brief: Glyph用基础模型与稀疏自编码器，从CT、报告和检验数据中提取隐特征，再映射为编码化临床概念，并评估其与患者结局的关联及预测价值。

papers.abstract: Automated scientific discovery has the potential to advance understanding of disease mechanisms and accelerate identification of early disease markers. Manual data annotation is infeasible at population scale, motivating methods that automatically extract pre-defined phenotypes in multimodal and unstructured clinical data. Such pre-defined feature sets determine and limit which associations these approaches can discover. This limitation extends to agentic AI systems that use these tools to query population-scale data. In contrast, foundation models (FMs) trained on large volumes of clinical data can perform tasks beyond their training objectives. This suggests their latent embeddings may represent novel or unexplored features that could yield insights into disease mechanisms, yet such latent features remain difficult to interpret. To address this challenge, we introduce Glyph, an automated multistage framework that extracts features from multimodal and unstructured clinical data using FMs and sparse autoencoders, interprets them as coded clinical concepts, and evaluates their value for clinical scientific discovery. We applied Glyph to abdominal CT volumes, CT radiology reports and laboratory measurements from 41,628 patients across different institutions. We identified 397 predictive concepts supported by 4,463 Bonferroni-significant associations. Moreover, a majority of discovered associations were automatically reproducible in held-out cohorts across different sites. Glyph concepts provided complementary associations to literature-derived markers, leading to gains in predictive power. We envision that interpretability can extend beyond a mechanistic understanding of neural networks to connecting implicitly learned features with clinical knowledge and establishing their significance for patient outcomes. We release Glyph at https://github.com/StanfordMIMI/Glyph.

papers.what_it_is: GameRealm是面向视觉基础模型的游戏多模态数据集。它通过人工操作与智能体探索统一采集，将画面与深度、音频、控制输入及三维轨迹同步对齐。

papers.abstract: Visual foundation models are central to physical intelligence, yet their development remains constrained by fragmented training datasets, inconsistent annotation quality, and limited multimodal supervision. To address these challenges, we introduce GameRealm, a large-scale, richly annotated dataset that grounds visual observations in synchronized, game-native supervision. GameRealm encompasses over 120 million RGB frames and 1,000 hours of gameplay footage across all views. Beyond its unprecedented scale, GameRealm provides rich multimodal supervision, including metric depth, camera parameters, synchronized audio, control inputs, and 3D point trajectories. Its diversity further extends to flexible view configurations, spanning single-view, stereo, multi-view, and panoramic recordings. To enable scalable acquisition across diverse game environments, we develop a unified data collection pipeline that combines human-operated interaction with agentic exploration. Extensive experiments across diverse visual learning tasks demonstrate that GameRealm consistently strengthens visual foundation models in both visual generation and geometric learning. These results establish GameRealm as a versatile and valuable data resource, unlocking new opportunities for advancing visual intelligence.

papers.brief: 提出面向交互场景的自回归视频扩散模型系列，通过剖析端到端推理瓶颈，用轻量替代方案重构解码与缓存更新，使逐帧生成达到毫秒级响应。
papers.tldr: 通过轻量化解码与缓存更新，让自回归视频扩散在保持画质时实现实时交互。
papers.what_it_is: 提出面向交互场景的自回归视频扩散模型系列，通过剖析端到端推理瓶颈，用轻量替代方案重构解码与缓存更新，使逐帧生成达到毫秒级响应。
key_points: VAE解码与KV缓存更新占端到端延迟一半以上
1.3B模型单张B200达36毫秒/帧，同等画质近8倍提速
14B模型用8张B200达45毫秒/帧，画质更优
papers.why_notable: 将加速重点从模型计算扩展到解码与缓存等系统环节，在保持画质的同时降低响应延迟，支持相机与物理条件驱动的实时交互。
papers.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. However, existing models are orders of magnitude too slow for fluid interaction. This paper introduces FastFrames, a family of fast autoregressive video diffusion models that achieves interactive latency without compromising quality. We profile the inference pipeline of state-of-the-art models and find that operations often treated as fixed implementation details, such as VAE decoding and KV cache updates, in fact account for over half of end-to-end inference latency. We challenge the assumption that these components are indispensable and replace them with lightweight alternatives. Our 1.3B variant runs at 36 ms per frame, or 28 responses per second (RPS), on a single B200 GPU while matching the generation quality of a state-of-the-art model that is nearly 8x slower. Our 14B variant runs at 45 ms per frame, or 22 RPS, on an 8x B200 GPU node and yields significantly better visual quality and realism. We show that FastFrames enables real-time interaction in applications such as camera-conditioned and physics-conditioned video generation.

papers.title: $π^4$: A Foundation Model for 4D Scene Geometry and Motion
papers.brief: 这是面向四维场景感知的基础模型，从未标定图像或视频恢复几何、相机位姿与尺度。它用几何条件化运动分支预测二维对应，再借目标视图几何提升为三维轨迹。
papers.tldr: 以共享骨干统一场景几何与运动恢复，单次前向处理未标定图像并扩展至千图场景。
papers.what_it_is: 这是面向四维场景感知的基础模型，从未标定图像或视频恢复几何、相机位姿与尺度。它用几何条件化运动分支预测二维对应，再借目标视图几何提升为三维轨迹。
key_points: 几何分支与几何条件化运动分支共享骨干，约5亿参数
几何评测平均排名最佳，兼顾二维／三维跟踪与运动物体分割
训练上下文最多64视图，推理可处理数千张图像
papers.why_notable: 它将重建与运动追踪整合为单次前向推理，参数量不足多数基线的一半；从短上下文训练扩展至千图场景，体现较强的规模泛化能力。
papers.abstract: $π^4$ is a unified foundation model for 4D scene perception. From diverse, uncalibrated RGB observations in the wild---a single image, an unordered collection, or a video sequence---it recovers dense geometry, camera poses, and metric scale, together with 2D/3D point tracks and moving-object masks for multi-image inputs. It couples a geometry branch with a geometry-conditioned motion branch, which predicts image-space correspondences that are lifted into 3D using reconstructed target-view geometry. Across diverse benchmarks, $π^4$ achieves the best overall average rank in geometry evaluation, alongside competitive performance in single- and multiview 2D/3D point tracking and moving-object segmentation. With a shared backbone, the full geometry-and-motion system contains approximately 0.5B parameters---less than half the size of most baselines. It produces joint reconstructions and tracks in one forward pass, including large-scale scenes with thousands of input images despite training with contexts of at most 64 views. We further present the data and training recipe underlying these capabilities, together with empirical studies of key design choices. Code and models are available at https://github.com/yyfz/Pi4.

papers.brief: 提出面向运行框架优化器的自改进记忆SIM，按反复出现的问题组织修改记录。保存修改理由、预期与实际效果及评测环境，支持更换模型或基准后继续优化。

papers.what_it_is: 提出面向运行框架优化器的自改进记忆SIM，按反复出现的问题组织修改记录。保存修改理由、预期与实际效果及评测环境，支持更换模型或基准后继续优化。

papers.abstract: Harness optimization is often studied with a fixed policy model and benchmark. When either changes, the optimizer must decide which parts of an evolved harness to reuse or revise, but the harness alone may not explain why earlier edits were made or how they performed. In this work, we study Continual Recursive Self-Improvement (CRSI), a setting for continuing existing harness-optimization methods across compatible benchmarks or policy models. We propose Self-Improvement Memory (SIM) for the harness optimizer, rather than the task-solving policy. SIM groups edits by recurring harness problem and records their rationale, predicted and observed outcomes, and evaluation context. New attempts extend this history as optimization continues. In our experiments across four domains, SIM achieves higher final scores than harness-only and root-cause-only continuation in cross-dataset and pairwise cross-model comparisons. Across ten independent source runs in coding, paired continuations with SIM improve final scores by an average of 2.36 points over harness-only continuation ($p=0.003$).

papers.abstract: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the series, spanning architecture selection, large-scale pretraining, and reasoning and agentic post-training. We study how sparse activation, attention design, model depth and width, and speculative decoding balance model capacity with computation, memory access, and execution overhead. Our pretraining infrastructure builds on MindSpore HyperParallel, combining topology-aware hybrid sharding, efficient distributed optimizer execution, and coordinated management of long-sequence workloads and activation memory. CPU affinity and core isolation further reduce host scheduling interference. Together, these mechanisms support the pretraining of a 285B-parameter model on 8,192 Ascend 910C cards, providing a concrete setting for the architectural and systems studies. For post-training, we introduce TeleGym, a unified agent execution platform that connects execution, evaluation, and trajectory construction to policy optimization. Disaggregated asynchronous execution, bounded oversampling, and partial rollout accommodate heterogeneous task durations while preserving trajectory continuity across policy updates. Together, these advances establish an Ascend-oriented training foundation for the continued development of Xing 4 across model scales and increasingly demanding reasoning and agent workloads.

papers.title: Regularized Score Centering
papers.brief: 提出正则化分数中心化，在消除奖励基线影响的更新中加入反向KL惩罚，约束学习策略偏离行为策略。可结合截断重要性采样，降低异步训练中的失稳风险。
papers.tldr: 通过反向KL约束策略漂移，稳定异步强化学习并提升智能体训练效率。
papers.what_it_is: 提出正则化分数中心化，在消除奖励基线影响的更新中加入反向KL惩罚，约束学习策略偏离行为策略。可结合截断重要性采样，降低异步训练中的失稳风险。
key_points: RSC加入反向KL惩罚，理论上改善收敛保证
结合TIS限制词元重要性权重，提升智能体样本效率
六项智能体任务领先；BabyAI达最强基线9.9倍

papers.abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. To limit this policy mismatch, we introduce Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty to encourage the learner's next-token distribution to stay close to the behavior policy's next-token distribution. RSC works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS), which caps token importance weights. Our theoretical analysis supports this approach, showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks, including online shopping, tool use, games, and fully asynchronous software engineering. RSC with TIS substantially improves sample efficiency across all agentic benchmarks, attaining higher training rewards with the same number of sampled responses. In final evaluations, it achieves top performance across all six agentic tasks, improving by 14.3% on AppWorld and reaching 9.9 times the strongest baseline's score on BabyAI.

papers.abstract: Driving world models usually generate videos from six pinhole cameras with separate optical centres and small overlaps, and must learn to keep these views consistent. We present PanDWM, which stitches them into one $360^\circ$ panoramic band. Camera boundaries then fall inside one image, so keeping the views consistent means keeping the image continuous, and each pixel still records its camera ray. Conditioned on layouts, a causal student generates the band window by window in four steps; it is distilled from a causal teacher and trained on its own rollouts. A feed-forward decoder lifts each frame along these rays into 3D Gaussians, and static Gaussians from neighbouring frames complete them into 4D scenes. On nuScenes, scored in one stitched $360^\circ$ view, PanDWM has lower FID and FVD than the multi-camera baselines at $8$-$46\times$ their speed, and keeps its 50-step teacher's FID while lowering FVD by 22-25%.

papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers specialized capabilities to language-model agents, but its cross-domain effects on interaction remain unclear. We investigate how OPD reshapes ReAct interaction patterns across mathematics, ALFWorld, and $τ^2$-bench, focusing on reasoning, actions, and observation acquisition. General-reasoning supervision reduces mathematical tool attempts from 70.4% to 14.4% while increasing accuracy from 16.7% to 38.0%; code-interpreter supervision improves household actions and retail queries. In contrast, ALFWorld supervision reduces $τ^2$-bench accuracy from 41.5% to 6.6%, accompanied by frequent tool calls that violate user-information dependencies. To address negative transfer using only source-domain training trajectories, we explore selective OPD guided by teacher preference changes before and after domain-specific RL. Retaining the top 95% of positions raises $τ^2$ accuracy from 11.5% to 29.9% with a source-learning trade-off.

papers.abstract: Can AI agents design robots that work in the real world? We introduce RoboBuilder, a benchmark in which coding agents co-design a robot's hardware and program from standard parts, motors and a custom 3D-printed part, and every design that passes in simulation is built and tested on a physical course. Simulation alone is not enough: under public part data, none of 15 initial passing designs crossed the real course, so an agent learns the simulator from measurements it requests and videos of real runs. Across four frontier coding agents, ten obstacles at three difficulty levels, 16,427 simulations of 12,774 distinct robots and 135 physical robots built in an estimated 240 hours, agents solve nearly all easy obstacles and invent mechanisms our search baselines do not reach, but falter at harder levels, when one robot must cross every obstacle, and in the real world, where 66% of simulated passes hold across all levels. Closing the loop helps: shown a video of its real failure, an agent redesigns the robot, sometimes correcting its simulator, and removes 72% of level-1 and level-2 failures. RoboBuilder measures progress toward agents that engineer real machines. Project Page: https://ghadinehme.com/robobuilder.github.io/

papers.title: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow
papers.brief: AnyS1从人工编写的程序化技能中挖掘可枚举决策，训练统一的轻量指针模型。运行时直接处理常规选择，置信度不足则回退大模型。
papers.tldr: 用统一轻量模型接管智能体常规决策，在保持可靠性的同时大幅降本提速。
papers.what_it_is: AnyS1从人工编写的程序化技能中挖掘可枚举决策，训练统一的轻量指针模型。运行时直接处理常规选择，置信度不足则回退大模型。
key_points: 从1000余项公开技能采集执行轨迹，构建Any-DP
训练4B指针模型，以标签平滑校准决策置信度
三项未见基准上成本降75–91%，调用耗时降63–92%
papers.why_notable: 将双系统分工从逐环境定制扩展到共享技能驱动，在保持任务可靠性的同时显著降低开销，且支持阈值零样本迁移。
papers.abstract: Autonomous LLM agents incur substantial cost and latency by invoking a large model (System-2) at every step, even when many intermediate actions choose among a small set of known candidates. Existing dual-system agents offload such decisions to a lightweight System-1 model, but rely on workflow-specific hooks authored per environment. We present AnyS1, a framework that turns human-authored procedural skills, whose instructions naturally specify where choices arise and which options apply, into a shared, domain-general source of decision points. Offline, AnyS1 mines grounded enumerable decisions across over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers to construct Any-DP, and trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing. At run time, compiled workflows resolve routine decisions in one forward pass and fall back to System-2 when confidence falls below a calibrated threshold. Across three unseen benchmarks and distinct System-2 model families, AnyS1 preserves task reliability while cutting episode cost by 75-91% and model-call time by 63-92% relative to an uncompiled System-2 agent, and maintains performance under zero-shot threshold transfer.

papers.title: ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models
papers.brief: ForceHarness为仅能通过API调用的冻结模型接入力觉，无需示范或微调。底层力控原语自主闭环并在接触事件终止，翻译层将力轨迹转为带不确定性的物理量。
papers.tldr: 通过自主力控与物理量反馈，让冻结多模态模型零样本完成接触操作。
papers.what_it_is: ForceHarness为仅能通过API调用的冻结模型接入力觉，无需示范或微调。底层力控原语自主闭环并在接触事件终止，翻译层将力轨迹转为带不确定性的物理量。
key_points: 自终止力控原语处理高速接触，物理翻译层提供可推理反馈
真实机械臂无腕部力传感器，成功率从3.3%升至90.0%
ForceBench与七任务HiddenPhys分别提升17.5、34.3个百分点
papers.why_notable: 将高速接触控制与模型决策解耦，为冻结模型提供可推理的物理反馈；零样本表现超过示范训练策略，并在HiddenPhys追平专家控制器。
papers.abstract: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. Bringing force to an API-only frozen model raises two challenges. First, contact evolves much faster than an API model can decide, so the system must close the loop on force beneath the model. Second, a frozen model cannot interpret raw force streams, so force must be returned in a form the model can reason about. Therefore, we present ForceHarness, a harness that lets frozen models use force without demonstrations or finetuning. After calibrating hand force from a wrist sensor or joint torques alone, ForceHarness addresses the first challenge with self-terminating force primitives that regulate force on their own and return at a contact event. To address the second challenge, a physics translation layer turns each force trace into physical quantities with uncertainty as the tool result. To evaluate ForceHarness against expert force controllers and learned policies under identical conditions, we also build HiddenPhys, a seven-task MuJoCo benchmark with hidden physical variables. On a real arm without a wrist force sensor, ForceHarness raises the zero-shot success rate of GPT-6 Astra from 3.3% to 90.0%. In simulation, it adds 17.5 percentage points on the public ForceBench suite and 34.3 percentage points on HiddenPhys, surpassing force-aware policies trained on demonstrations on both benchmarks and matching hand-written expert controllers on HiddenPhys. Ablations further show that smaller models make significantly better decisions when given physical quantities rather than raw force values.

papers.title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
papers.brief: AscendGYM评测模型与智能体优化既有昇腾内核的能力，采用真实训练、推理任务的输入配置，并提供执行环境与内置搜索框架。
papers.tldr: 以真实负载评测昇腾内核优化能力，并将加速收益与令牌成本联合计分。
papers.what_it_is: AscendGYM评测模型与智能体优化既有昇腾内核的能力，采用真实训练、推理任务的输入配置，并提供执行环境与内置搜索框架。
key_points: 首批包含48个内核，覆盖三个难度等级
支持模型评测与模型—执行框架联合评测
STS指标衡量加速收益相对于令牌成本的表现
papers.why_notable: 将评测重点从生成内核转向真实负载下的优化，并纳入令牌预算，有助于比较模型与智能体的实际优化效率。
papers.abstract: Kernel optimization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) training and inference on Ascend NPUs. Existing Ascend kernel benchmarks primarily focus on kernel generation, with less emphasis on the ability of agents to optimize existing implementations under input configurations drawn from real workloads. To address this requirement, we introduce AscendGYM, a benchmark whose initial suite comprises 48 kernels across three difficulty levels. Each kernel is paired with test cases whose data types and tensor shapes are collected from real-world training and inference tasks. Consequently, performance improvements on AscendGYM map directly to the corresponding workloads. In terms of usability, two evaluation modes are supported in AscendGYM: model evaluation and model-harness evaluation. The kernel optimization capabilities of both trained models and custom agents are allowed to be measured. It provides a complete execution environment that closely reproduces how Ascend kernels are invoked in practical pipelines. For model evaluation, it additionally includes a built-in harness equipped with search orchestration and experience accumulation. Finally, we propose a new metric, the Speedup-Token Score (STS), which quantifies performance gains relative to token cost. By jointly considering speedup and cost, STS enables the assessment of practical kernel optimization capability of a model or harness under an acceptable budget. AscendGYM is available at https://github.com/SLAI-AITP/AscendGYM.

papers.title: Multi-Branch Transformer
papers.brief: MBT在共享前后层之间并行执行独立参数的多组Transformer块，再融合输出；结合Balanced分支配置与Joint-KV共享缓存优化推理。
papers.tldr: 通过并行分支与共享缓存，语言模型在同等训练预算下兼顾质量和解码效率。
papers.what_it_is: MBT在共享前后层之间并行执行独立参数的多组Transformer块，再融合输出；结合Balanced分支配置与Joint-KV共享缓存优化推理。
key_points: 在0.8B至2.1B参数的四个MoE规模上验证
拟合曲线显示基线匹配损失需至多1.26倍主体训练计算
Joint-KV缓存最多减34%，H200解码吞吐增51.4%
papers.why_notable: 将并行分支作为宽度、深度之外的扩展路径，在匹配预算下提升建模质量，并让结构改动同时带来可量化的推理收益。
papers.abstract: Transformer language models are commonly scaled by making their blocks wider or stacking them deeper. In this work, we explore a complementary path: branching, the parallel composition of full Transformer blocks. We introduce the Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT), which processes the input through shared initial layers, executes independently parameterized branches of sequential blocks in parallel, and fuses their outputs before shared final layers. At comparable training compute, we study three MBT variants: Wide-Shallow preserves block width, Narrow-Deep preserves sequential depth, and Balanced interpolates between them. In controlled pretraining experiments at four mixture-of-experts scales (0.8B to 2.1B total parameters), 2-branch Wide-Shallow MBTs consistently outperform sequential Transformers under matched parameter and training-compute budgets. Balanced MBTs improve further and retain comparable quality as the number of branches increases. To improve inference efficiency at long contexts, we introduce Joint-KV, which constructs a shared KV cache from branch representations at each depth. Our final recipe combines Balanced MBTs with Joint-KV, supported by an inference engine that exploits branch grouping and shared-cache reuse. Fitted scaling curves indicate that standard Transformers require up to 1.26x as much training body compute to match our final models' validation loss. These models reduce full-model KV-cache storage by up to 34% and deliver up to 51.4% higher decoding throughput on a single H200 GPU. Ablation studies show that branching yields gains beyond changes in width and depth, enables an effective KV-sharing strategy (Joint-KV), remains robust across fusion functions, and performs best in the middle layers. These findings show that branching offers a practical path for scaling language models toward both better modeling quality and faster inference.

papers.title: TCP4D: A Unified Tool-Center-Point Tracking and Generation Model for Robot Manipulation
papers.brief: TCP4D以工具中心点位姿为动作空间，从单目视频恢复运动及夹爪状态。共享四维场景表征进一步结合机器人观测与语言指令，预测未来轨迹。
papers.tldr: 用共享四维场景表征统一机械臂动作恢复与生成，支持跨机器人迁移。
papers.what_it_is: TCP4D以工具中心点位姿为动作空间，从单目视频恢复运动及夹爪状态。共享四维场景表征进一步结合机器人观测与语言指令，预测未来轨迹。
key_points: 跟踪器在DROID与RoboLab误差为7.60和16.07毫米
跨形态增强无需源机器人状态，十条示范即可适配新形态
生成器在RoboTwin平均成功率达69.19%
papers.why_notable: 将视频动作标注、策略生成与跨机器人数据增强串联起来；源数据与增强数据联合训练，相比仅用增强数据使目标机器人成功率提升41.5%。
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation videos provide a rich visual experience, yet recovering robot action and gripper-state annotations from RGB observations still remains challenging. Using the embodiment-agnostic tool-center-point (TCP) pose as the action space, we present TCP4D, a unified model in which a shared 4D scene representation both tracks observed TCP motion and generates future TCP trajectories. Given a monocular video and initial 2D TCP queries, the tracker directly recovers metric TCP poses in SE(3) and gripper states alongside scene geometry and camera parameters. The generator samples local features from the same 4D representation along the recovered TCP tracks, then combines them with robot observations and language instructions to predict future TCP states. Our new cross-embodiment augmentation pipeline converts existing RGB videos into demonstrations for alternative embodiments by retargeting the recovered motion and synthesizing the corresponding observations, without recorded source-robot states. Experiments show that the tracker achieves absolute trajectory errors of 7.60 and 16.07 mm on DROID and RoboLab and adapts to a new embodiment with only ten demonstrations. The generator achieves 69.19% mean success on RoboTwin and outperforms well-established policy models on two real-world tasks, while joint training on source and augmented demonstrations improves target-robot success by 41.5% over augmented-only training.

papers.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
papers.brief: 研究让三个前沿大模型仅凭十个标注样例和沙箱，直接编写权重或自行设计架构。自由设计时，它们均将文本事实编译为稀疏表，再用固定程序查询。
papers.tldr: 让大模型直接编写权重时，稀疏查表结构比手写权重的Transformer更高效。
papers.what_it_is: 研究让三个前沿大模型仅凭十个标注样例和沙箱，直接编写权重或自行设计架构。自由设计时，它们均将文本事实编译为稀疏表，再用固定程序查询。
key_points: 稀疏表在以多选题为主的测试中，准确率最高54.4%
自设计模型胜过同一大模型写出的Transformer，参数少约1800倍
提出关联记忆模型，GPU速度最高达同规模Transformer的17倍
papers.why_notable: 结果表明，脱离梯度训练后，架构选择可能转向可解释、可局部修改的查表结构；优势针对直接写权重，预训练大模型仍更准确。
papers.abstract: Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs. In weight-space programming, a large language model (LLM) writes target weights by hand without gradient-based training, so those reasons no longer apply. Should we keep the Transformer? Given minimal guidance, ten labeled examples, and a sandbox, mainly on multiple-choice questions, we task three frontier LLMs with either generating the weights of a fixed architecture or designing the architecture themselves. When free to design, all three compile plain-text facts into a sparse table queried by a fixed procedure, reaching up to 54.4% test accuracy. An LLM-designed model achieves higher test accuracy than the most accurate released Transformer that the same LLM wrote while using about 1,800x fewer parameters. Without gradients, they choose a table, in which the LLM can state what each weight means and can find and rewrite a wrong one. Each wrong answer points to one row, and removing a row changes about one other answer. From this, we propose an associative-memory-based model up to 17x faster on GPUs than a same-sized Transformer. We also test pretrained weights, other benchmarks, and tasks where models generate answers. Pretrained LLMs remain more accurate; the claim concerns which structure to build when writing weights.
papers.organization: Pohang University of Science and Technology

papers.title: Heave-Ho: Decentralized Long-Horizon Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
papers.brief: 提出去中心化人形机器人协作框架，以多智能体后训练适配基础动作跟踪模型，再结合视觉语言规划器与语音主从协调，实现长时程移动操作。
papers.tldr: 通过局部控制与语音协调，实现可扩展的多个人形机器人长时程协作
papers.what_it_is: 提出去中心化人形机器人协作框架，以多智能体后训练适配基础动作跟踪模型，再结合视觉语言规划器与语音主从协调，实现长时程移动操作。
key_points: 多智能体后训练支持仅凭局部观测的耦合控制
视觉语言规划器与语音主从机制实现无网络同步
双机器人训练扩展至十台；HH-Bench含12项任务
papers.why_notable: 将全身控制、长时程规划与执行同步整合起来，支持异构团队免重训练泛化，并通过真实机器人实验验证协作能力。
papers.abstract: Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. However, realizing this potential requires coordinated whole-body interactions, coherent long-horizon planning, and precise synchronization across robots. We introduce Heave-Ho, a decentralized framework for long-horizon collaborative multi-humanoid loco-manipulation. At the low level, we develop a multi-agent post-training framework that adapts a humanoid foundation tracking model to physically coupled interactions between humanoids, enabling coordinated decentralized control from local observations alone. At the high level, we train a vision-language planner and design a speech-based leader-follower coordination mechanism to synchronize decentralized execution without network communication. Trained with two identical humanoids, our system scales to teams of up to ten robots and generalizes to heterogeneous teams without retraining. To benchmark these capabilities, we introduce HH-Bench, comprising 12 tasks involving teams of 2 to 10 humanoids, including heterogeneous teams. Systematic evaluations show that Heave-Ho consistently outperforms baseline methods, while real-world experiments demonstrate robust decentralized collaboration across challenging tasks.

papers.title: Beyond Answering: Learning to Speak First and Act in Streaming Video
papers.brief: AURA 2.0将主动对话、工具调用与双向视觉定位融入流式视频模型。通过专用交互数据集和三阶段训练学习新行为，并用长时交互记忆维持上下文。
papers.tldr: 让视频流助手不再只等提问，而能主动开聊、调用工具并定位画面对象。
papers.what_it_is: AURA 2.0将主动对话、工具调用与双向视觉定位融入流式视频模型。通过专用交互数据集和三阶段训练学习新行为，并用长时交互记忆维持上下文。
key_points: MIC识别视频中值得讨论的话题并适时主动开聊
SATC依据视觉与对话上下文调用工具并整合返回信息
IVG识别用户标记对象，输出帧对齐边界框
papers.why_notable: 把流式视频理解推进到主动交互与工具行动，公开基准表现位居开源流式模型前列，为持续感知型助手提供实现路径。
papers.abstract: Most AI assistants respond only when prompted, remaining silent even when events in the video stream offer meaningful opportunities for conversation. To move beyond purely user-driven interaction, we present AURA 2.0, a streaming video large language model that introduces three core upgrades to AURA. The key advance is Model-Initiated Conversation (MIC), which enables the model to identify topics worth discussing in the evolving visual stream and initiate conversations at appropriate moments without a user query. Stream-Aware Tool Calling (SATC) lets the model act on what it sees by invoking external tools using the current visual and conversational context and incorporating returned information into the ongoing interaction. Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG) supports visual grounding in both user inputs and model outputs. The model can identify objects marked by users on video frames and produce frame-aligned bounding boxes to link its responses to specific objects and regions. To develop these capabilities, we construct a dedicated streaming interaction dataset and adopt a three-stage training scheme to integrate the new behaviors with AURA's existing streaming interaction abilities. We further incorporate Long-Horizon Interaction Memory (LHIM) to maintain contextual continuity over extended video streams. Evaluations on public streaming benchmarks show that AURA 2.0 achieves leading performance among open-source streaming models, while targeted evaluations further validate its new interaction capabilities.

papers.title: Breath-Dx: A Time Series Classification Benchmark for Disease Screening with eNose
papers.brief: 研究构建电子鼻呼气疾病筛查基准，利用公开临床多变量时间序列比较十种分类方法。通过显式时间划分训练与测试集，检验传感器漂移下的真实泛化表现。
papers.tldr: 呼气疾病筛查基准揭示传感器漂移影响，随机交叉验证明显高估诊断性能。
papers.what_it_is: 研究构建电子鼻呼气疾病筛查基准，利用公开临床多变量时间序列比较十种分类方法。通过显式时间划分训练与测试集，检验传感器漂移下的真实泛化表现。
key_points: S-OH含1234名患者、9个诊断组及17通道序列
比较4类共10种方法，时间验证使AUC下降0.05—0.12
部分肺部疾病最佳ROC AUC为0.74—0.76
papers.why_notable: 将传感器漂移纳入可复现评测，暴露随机划分的乐观偏差；同时检验年龄混杂，帮助区分呼气信号的独立诊断价值。
papers.abstract: Electronic nose (eNose) technology offers a portable, non-invasive route for disease screening via exhaled breath analysis. However, progress in the field is hindered by the lack of systematic benchmarks that compare machine learning methods under realistic conditions, particularly sensor drift, a known but rarely quantified failure mode. Most existing studies rely on small, private datasets with inconsistent protocols, rendering results non-comparable and slowing progress. We introduce Breath-Dx, the first comprehensive benchmark of time series classification methods for breath-based disease screening. Our work leverages the Scent of Health (S-OH) dataset, the largest public clinical eNose collection to date, comprising 1,234 patients across nine diagnostic groups, each providing a 17-channel multivariate time series with explicit temporal train/test splits that account for sensor drift. We systematically evaluate 10 methods spanning four families: feature-based tabular learners, convolution-based models, graph-based, and time series architectures. All methods degrade significantly under temporal validation (0.05-0.12 AUC drop compared to random cross-validation), confirming that drift embeds a strong temporal signal. Under this realistic evaluation, the best methods achieve ROC AUC of 0.74-0.76 for some lung conditions, though others remain near chance. Recurrent architectures show the most consistent performance across diseases, while specialized time series methods achieve the highest peak results. Demographic confounders matter: breath signals provide independent diagnostic value for some conditions but add little beyond age for others. We release the S-OH dataset, all temporal splits, evaluation protocols, and code to enable reproducible research and accelerate progress in clinical breathomics.

papers.title: CADMAGEDDON: High-Fidelity CAD Reconstruction with Local Inference
papers.brief: 这是一个可本地运行的开源CAD重建智能体，将网格转换为可编辑模型。它把构建与修正拆成连续视觉决策，用几何工具完成精确建模。
papers.tldr: 将网格重建为可编辑CAD，本地中型模型在主要基准上超越前沿模型方案。
papers.what_it_is: 这是一个可本地运行的开源CAD重建智能体，将网格转换为可编辑模型。它把构建与修正拆成连续视觉决策，用几何工具完成精确建模。
key_points: 采用Qwen3.8-27B，支持单GPU及当代笔记本
以视觉决策链规划构建和修正，几何工具负责精确操作
集成FreeCAD，所有主要基准的重建质量优于既有方案
papers.why_notable: 它把高质量CAD重建带到本地设备，减少专有零件外传需求；同时接入现有工程工作流，降低个人和小企业的使用门槛。
papers.abstract: CAD practitioners often work with proprietary parts that they are unwilling to share with external services. For individuals and small companies, bringing this work in-house also requires computational resources they can afford. We introduce CADMAGEDDON, an open-source agent that reconstructs editable CAD from meshes and can run locally on single-GPU systems and current-generation laptops. The method decomposes this complex task into a chain of simple visual decisions about what to construct and what to correct. Geometric tools support precise construction, allowing the agent to focus on visual reasoning. Using the mid-sized Qwen3.8-27B model, CADMAGEDDON outperforms prior approaches, including systems based on frontier models, in reconstruction quality on all the main benchmarks. CADMAGEDDON integrates with FreeCAD, bringing its reconstructions into practitioners' existing CAD workflows. Code: https://github.com/kulibinai/cadmageddon

papers.title: FMT: Lossless Image Compression in a Fixed Number of Parallel Steps
papers.brief: 提出无损图像格式FMT，联合设计解码顺序与熵编码。通过粗到细树组织独立像素值，让GPU逐步批量预测，并以并行rANS通道解码。
papers.tldr: FMT以固定步数并行解码，在保持无损压缩率的同时显著提速。
papers.what_it_is: 提出无损图像格式FMT，联合设计解码顺序与熵编码。通过粗到细树组织独立像素值，让GPU逐步批量预测，并以并行rANS通道解码。
key_points: FMT让任意尺寸图像均以固定数量顺序步骤解码
并行rANS通道跨步骤保留状态，减少串行等待
同一A100上，Kodak解码快9至61倍，体积相当或更小
papers.why_notable: 将学习式无损压缩的速度瓶颈从串行依赖入手解决；无网络版本也在体积与速度上胜过HTJ2K，展示格式设计本身的价值。
papers.abstract: Learned lossless codecs make smaller files than common classical codecs, yet the images we archive and train on still use classical codecs. A main reason is time: a learned codec takes seconds to decode a photo that a classical codec opens in milliseconds, and their faster variants give up most of their gain in size. We argue that much of this time is spent waiting, not computing: the network waits for the values it conditions on, and the arithmetic decoder reads them one at a time. We introduce FMT (Fixed-step Multiscale Tree), a lossless image format whose decoding order and entropy coder are designed together so that neither wait grows with the image. FMT stores an image as a coarse-to-fine tree whose steps hold independent values: a GPU predicts each step at once and decodes it in parallel rANS lanes that carry their states from step to step, so an image of any size decodes in a fixed number of sequential steps. On this tree we build a family of bit-exact codecs, from a rule with no network to large networks, and no codec we ran on the same GPU beats any of them on both size and speed. Without a network, FMT beats NVIDIA's HTJ2K on size and speed; with a large one, it decodes Kodak photos 9 to 61X faster than learned codecs we ran on the same A100, at the same size or smaller.

papers.title: MPEG-Diffusion: Mixed-Resolution Video Generation
papers.brief: 该方法让视频重要区域以高分辨率生成，其余区域采用低分辨率。通过双分辨率注意力、混合潜变量解码及模型自主选区，缓解画质退化并免去预先指定区域。
papers.tldr: 通过自动选择高分辨率区域与双分辨率建模，大幅加速视频生成并保持画质。
papers.what_it_is: 该方法让视频重要区域以高分辨率生成，其余区域采用低分辨率。通过双分辨率注意力、混合潜变量解码及模型自主选区，缓解画质退化并免去预先指定区域。
key_points: 双分辨率注意力让查询读取同分辨率的K/V
混合分辨率解码器融合高低分辨率潜变量，减轻失真
仅处理30%全分辨率令牌，14B模型去噪加速4.8倍
papers.why_notable: 它将混合分辨率生成推进到无需人工指定区域的实用方案；用户评测中，超90%的成对比较优于既有方法，画质接近全分辨率。
papers.abstract: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) generate realistic videos, but their heavy computational cost limits broader real-world applications. Mixed-resolution generation reduces this cost by generating the visually important region at high resolution (HR) and the rest at low resolution (LR), yet existing methods suffer a severe quality drop on videos and require knowing the HR region in advance. We show that these failures are not inherent to mixed resolution, and propose $\textbf{MPEG-Diffusion}$ to address their three root causes: (1) dual-resolution attention to mitigate the curse of mixed resolution, where each query reads the K/V of its own resolution, (2) a mixed-resolution decoder to blend the HR and LR latents before decoding and resolve distortion, and (3) a self-selected HR region using the DiT's knowledge to find the visually important region without requiring it in advance. Processing only $30\%$ of full-resolution tokens, MPEG-Diffusion speeds up denoising by $4.8\times$ on Wan2.1 14B ($3.8\times$ on 1.3B), outperforming prior methods on nearly every metric. In the user study, we demonstrate the high quality of MPEG-Diffusion, with raters preferring it over prior mixed-resolution methods in over $90\%$ of pairs and rating it close to full resolution.

papers.title: DNeo: Your Parallel Draft Model Needs Better Target Feature Encoding
papers.brief: 提出并行草稿架构DNeo，以轻量级MoFA注意力编码目标模型特征，并记忆被拒绝的提案；结合非均匀选层等设计，改善草稿质量与推理速度。
papers.tldr: 通过改进目标特征编码与拒绝记忆，并行草稿模型实现更快且不降质的生成。
papers.what_it_is: 提出并行草稿架构DNeo，以轻量级MoFA注意力编码目标模型特征，并记忆被拒绝的提案；结合非均匀选层等设计，改善草稿质量与推理速度。
key_points: MoFA针对残差混合造成的特征编码损失
拒绝记忆保存此前未通过验证的提案
较DFlash-2提速1.3倍，模型占用与生成质量不变
papers.why_notable: 将推测解码优化重点转向目标特征编码与历史拒绝信息，在不增加草稿模型占用的情况下提速，为低成本大模型推理提供新路径。
papers.abstract: Speculative-diffusion decoding uses a small parallel drafter model to generate b draft tokens in one forward pass, which then undergo parallel verification via a larger target model. Faster inference can be achieved when multiple draft tokens pass verification simultaneously. Recent parallel draft architectures (DFlash, DSpark) improve draft quality by conditioning on rich features computed by the target, through a mechanism known as feature encoding. However, standard feature encoding mechanisms have three limitations: (1) they are lossy, applying encoding projections that are destructive to the underlying target feature-space via a discovered effect known as residual mixing, (2) they are memory-less, with no record of previously processed proposals, and (3) they utilize features sampled uniformly from across the target layers, omitting important hidden states. To address these issues, we propose Mixture-of-Features Attention (MoFA), a lightweight feature-encoding approach equipped with a working memory that encodes previously rejected proposals. Leveraging MoFA, rejection memory, and a set of further enhancements, including 2-tap causal convolutions, prefix-only cross-attention, and non-uniform target layer selection, the final architecture, DNeo, achieves 1.3x faster generation speed than SoTA (DFlash-2) without impacting drafter footprint or generation quality. DNeo marks a new state of the art in high quality, fast LLM inference.

papers.title: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
papers.brief: ResWAM在冻结的DINOv3特征空间学习当前到未来的视觉残差，聚焦机器人与物体运动；以双分支DiT通过条件流匹配联合学习动作和残差。
papers.tldr: 只预测视觉变化而非完整未来画面，提升机器人策略成功率并降低计算开销。
papers.what_it_is: ResWAM在冻结的DINOv3特征空间学习当前到未来的视觉残差，聚焦机器人与物体运动；以双分支DiT通过条件流匹配联合学习动作和残差。
key_points: 总参数2.3B，双分支DiT仅0.5B
无额外机器人预训练，LIBERO-Plus成功率81.1%
真机平均成功率80%，推理延迟92.7毫秒
papers.why_notable: 将未来预测的监督从静态背景转向任务相关变化，在多个基准和真机上兼顾成功率与计算效率，为闭环机器人部署提供更轻量的路线。
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world. Existing WAMs supervise complete future observations. However, observations typically change little over an action chunk, so the future loss is dominated by copying static background content rather than learning task-relevant robot and object motion, limiting policy learning. Moreover, existing WAMs rely on large video generation models or separate world models, incurring heavy training and inference compute that hinders closed-loop deployment. To improve policy performance, we propose visual residual learning, supervising only the feature change from the current frame to the future frame in a frozen DINOv3 space. Compared with complete future features, this residual learning target yields a higher feature rank with richer and more diverse representations of scene changes, and spatially concentrates on the robot arm and manipulated objects rather than the background. To further improve computational efficiency, we present ResWAM, a residual world-action model with 2.3B parameters in total, including a lightweight 0.5B dual-branch DiT that jointly trains an action branch and a residual branch via conditional flow matching. Without robot pretraining (i.e., pretraining on external robot action trajectories beyond the benchmark demonstrations), ResWAM achieves top average success rates on LIBERO-Plus (81.1%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.8%), and RoboDojo (9.40% success, 13.41 score) at the lowest training (2.7-4.0 TFLOPs) and inference compute (1.0-1.4 TFLOPs), and leads real-robot Open, Put, and Stack (80.0% average, +10.0% over $π_{0.5}$) at 92.7 ms latency.

papers.title: MillBill: A Machining Agent with Geometric Feedback
papers.brief: MillBill用本地中型模型为零件规划加工工序与切削参数，几何工具负责生成刀路、仿真去料并反馈修订；装夹规划考虑刀具实际可达性。
papers.tldr: 将加工决策与几何执行解耦，让本地语言模型借助仿真反馈改进加工方案。
papers.what_it_is: MillBill用本地中型模型为零件规划加工工序与切削参数，几何工具负责生成刀路、仿真去料并反馈修订；装夹规划考虑刀具实际可达性。
key_points: 面向分度三轴加工，输入边界表示零件、毛坯与材料
几何工具生成刀路并仿真去料，反馈驱动计划修订
Qwen3.8-27B在所测任务上优于前沿模型方案
papers.why_notable: 把数值执行交给几何工具，使中型开源模型也能处理精密加工规划；以公差内目标表面积占比衡量加工质量，更贴近制造要求。
papers.abstract: Turning a CAD model into a machining program requires both process knowledge and geometric precision. Language models can generate such workflows by writing geometry and toolpath code for each part, but this makes numerical execution part of the model's task. We introduce MillBill, an agent that separates machining decisions from their geometric execution and verification. Given a boundary-representation part, stock, and material, a locally hosted, mid-sized open model proposes operations and cutting parameters for indexed three-axis machining. A geometric harness generates toolpaths, simulates material removal, and returns feedback for plan refinement. Setup planning accounts for what the available cutters can physically reach, rather than visibility alone. We evaluate the resulting programs by the fraction of the target surface area within the specified tolerance after simulated machining. With Qwen3.8-27B, MillBill outperforms frontier-model approaches that construct their own geometry and toolpath workflows on the evaluated machining tasks. Code: https://github.com/kulibinai/millbill

papers.title: The Noise Floor of a Quantization Comparison: Engine, restart, batch and kernel drift, measured against 8-bit and 4-bit effects in two decision models
papers.brief: 研究在两个决策模型上拆分引擎、重启、批量与内核变化造成的漂移，再对照八位和四位量化效应，以逐条决策变化补充准确率评估。
papers.tldr: 量化评测需扣除运行环境噪声，四位量化的决策漂移仍显著高于噪声。
papers.what_it_is: 研究在两个决策模型上拆分引擎、重启、批量与内核变化造成的漂移，再对照八位和四位量化效应，以逐条决策变化补充准确率评估。
key_points: 9B与27B模型共测2400条决策，环境漂移最高0.92%
四位量化决策漂移3.50%至5.79%，区间均排除环境噪声
Q4_K_M准确率仅降0.02点，却有436条决策变差
papers.why_notable: 为量化比较提供可测量的环境噪声基线，揭示净准确率可能掩盖大量决策退化；代码与逐条输出开放，便于复核。
papers.abstract: A quantized model is usually judged by comparing it with its BF16 original, but that comparison changes more than the weights. It often changes the serving engine, it always runs on a different server instance, it may change how requests are batched, and on some stacks the library selects a different kernel depending only on which packages import. We measure each of these sources on the same 2,400 public decisions for two of Cloudflare's decision models, Clef-flash (9B) and Clef (27B), on an NVIDIA GB10, and state every quantization effect as the excess over them. Sources that are not quantization move between 0 and 0.92% of decisions. llama.cpp restarts are bit-identical on every record for both models. vLLM restarts flip 0, 5 and 20 decisions at BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 on Clef-flash and 4, 0 and 22 on Clef; a third instance of Clef's quantized builds (exploratory) leaves FP8 at 0 and puts NVFP4 at 4 to 22, depending on which two instances are compared. An engine change at BF16 flips 6 to 16, a batch-size change 8 to 15, and the Gated DeltaNet kernel transformers selects unasked 10 to 14. Quantization inside one engine moves more: for Clef-flash and Clef, 0.88% and 1.04% at Q8_0, 2.12% and 1.62% at FP8, 5.79% and 3.50% at Q4_K_M, and 5.79% and 5.67% at NVFP4. On both models, every 4-bit interval excludes every non-quantization source. Two of our five pre-registered predictions failed, and the same two fail when the tests are rerun on the 27B: FP8 is not inside restart noise, and changing engine moves fewer decisions than 8-bit quantization does. Accuracy hides most of this. Over the full 31,275 public questions, Clef's Q4_K_M build moves accuracy by a net six questions (-0.02 points [-0.20, +0.16]) while 436 of its decisions get worse (exploratory), and NVFP4 costs Clef-flash 0.95 points and Clef 0.65. We release the code, quantization recipes, per-record outputs and the pre-registration.

papers.title: HubEgo-100K: In-the-Wild Egocentric Video of Skilled Work for Robot Learning
papers.brief: 构建面向机器人学习的真实工作第一视角数据集，由参与者用头戴手机记录非脚本化技能操作，同步采集惯性数据，并提供机器生成的动作与语言标注。
papers.tldr: 以万小时真实工作第一视角视频，为机器人学习提供多环境技能数据。
papers.what_it_is: 构建面向机器人学习的真实工作第一视角数据集，由参与者用头戴手机记录非脚本化技能操作，同步采集惯性数据，并提供机器生成的动作与语言标注。
key_points: v1.0含10,124小时1080p视频及100Hz IMU
覆盖15,548个环境，83%时长来自工作场所
72,754段视频，以LeRobot和MCAP格式开放
papers.why_notable: 将数据扩展重点从重复示范转向环境与任务多样性，补足真实技能工作视频的缺口，为研究机器人跨场景泛化提供大规模资源。
papers.abstract: Robot policies trained by imitation generalize poorly outside the environments and objects seen in training. Published data-scaling studies find that generalization grows with the diversity of training environments and objects rather than with more demonstrations per environment. Robot data is costly to collect across many environments, whereas egocentric human video can be recorded in the wild at scale; existing egocentric video, however, mostly shows daily-life activity and contains little skilled work in real workplaces. We present HubEgo-100K, a dataset built for diversity. This version of the paper covers the first release, v1.0: 10,124 hours of 1080p egocentric video with synchronized 100 Hz inertial (IMU) data from one head-mounted phone camera. In v1.0, 12,227 contributors record their own unscripted work in 15,548 environments (each one contributor's own setting of one type, such as their kitchen or workshop) across 11 setting types, 30 work categories, 56 task types and 35 action families, with 83% of hours in workplace settings. The release comprises 72,754 episodes with machine-generated action and language annotations, in LeRobot and MCAP formats under CC BY 4.0. We measure diversity along each axis, show that inside v1.0, with episodes in random order, new contributors and words keep appearing, and relate the measurements to published evidence on six data properties tied to policy performance, including hand visibility and inertial sensing. We also document collection, curation, privacy measures and data format, and provide a datasheet. Later versions of this paper will add benchmarks and cover further releases toward 100,000 hours.

papers.title: Attention at Absolute Zero
papers.brief: 提出以元素对为状态的高阶注意力，用第三元素的两条关联评估支持项。零温读取最优项及并列数，仅传递计数比较位，每轮重建状态，只用答案训练。
papers.tldr: 零温高阶注意力以最优支持项及并列计数，实现跨规模泛化与可验证推理。
papers.what_it_is: 提出以元素对为状态的高阶注意力，用第三元素的两条关联评估支持项。零温读取最优项及并列数，仅传递计数比较位，每轮重建状态，只用答案训练。
key_points: 最大值检索扩至训练规模千倍，十个种子准确率均≥99.95%
CLRS-30无提示版本超过已发表最佳模型
冻结7B模型，关系链从16条扩至千条仍完全正确
papers.why_notable: 把离散选择与计数比较引入注意力，显著改善规模外推；有限权重检查还能证明部分关系推理模块在任意规模下正确。
papers.abstract: Attention scores candidate supports of an answer, which we call witnesses, and reads the scores at a temperature. We build a higher-order attention layer whose state lives on pairs of items: for a pair (a, b), each third item k is a witness judged through its legs (a, k) and (k, b). It reads witnesses at zero temperature, keeping the best and the number tied with it, passes on only bits comparing such counts, rebuilds its pair state from the input and these bits at every loop, and is trained from answers alone. Each choice removes one way soft attention fails at size: dispersed weight, unresolved gaps between learned scores, and a drifting soft state. In maximum retrieval it is right on at least 99.95% of sets 1,000 times larger than in training, on all ten seeds; trained with a soft count, the same network falls to 42% at 4,096 items. On CLRS-30 without hints, a general form of the layer (half its channels read at zero temperature, numbers embedded, state carried) beats the best published model, which uses hints on some tasks; the full cold layer is exact on every test input of 9 of the 12 tasks whose answers depend on numbers only through comparisons. From yes-or-no answers it decides 2-SAT and two-colouring exactly at 500 variables and, as our theory predicts, not parity equations. Beside a frozen 7B language model it chains family relations exactly at 1,000 statements after training on 16, where the model alone falls to 44%; finite checks on the weights prove every block that learned correct at every size, on acyclic contexts and given what the model reads. On CLUTRR it is right on every story of five to ten relations given the graphs, learning the 62 rules exactly; from text, with the model frozen, no hand-written rule and only a small read-in trained, it lifts an open 7B model from 33% to 65%, above every system we found without hand-written rules except frontier reasoning models.

papers.title: M3OPD-Reasoner: An Open Recipe for Post-Training Multimodal Reasoning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.brief: 提出开放的视觉语言模型后训练流程：以GSPO训练领域教师，再让学生基于自身生成回答进行多教师蒸馏，最后叠加混合强化学习。
papers.tldr: 多教师蒸馏后再做强化学习，让单一视觉语言模型兼顾三类推理能力。
papers.what_it_is: 提出开放的视觉语言模型后训练流程：以GSPO训练领域教师，再让学生基于自身生成回答进行多教师蒸馏，最后叠加混合强化学习。
key_points: 构建135万条SFT与19.3万条可验证奖励RL数据
Qwen3.5-9B经GSPO教师、MOPD及MixRL训练
在21个去污染评测集上，蒸馏平均优于混训基线
papers.why_notable: 展示多教师蒸馏与混合强化学习可连续利用同批数据提升能力，并公开数据、训练代码及各阶段权重，便于复现与比较。
papers.abstract: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) enables a single student to absorb the skills of several domain teachers by learning from its own generated responses. We present Multimodal Model Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation Reasoner (M3OPD-Reasoner), a fully open recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs) over three reasoning domains: image STEM, image perception, and video. We curate two datasets, M3OPD-SFT-1.35M for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and M3OPD-RL-193K for reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards. On these data, we compare post-training recipes that start from Qwen3.5-9B: training one model on the mixed data of all domains (MixSFT and MixRL), and training one teacher per domain with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO), directly or after an SFT warm-up, and distilling the teachers into one student with MOPD. We evaluate on 21 image STEM, image perception, and video reasoning benchmarks after we decontaminate the training data against them. The comparison establishes MOPD of teachers trained with GSPO directly from Qwen3.5-9B as the best recipe: the student closely matches each teacher on its own domain and is on average above the mixed-training baselines on the same prompts. Since MOPD already merges the domain capabilities that MixRL would otherwise have to learn, its student is a stronger starting point for RL, and we ask whether the same data can carry the model further from there: we add MixRL on top of the MOPD student, on the same prompts and with the same settings, which, to our knowledge, no prior VLM recipe has studied. The same prompts still improve the MOPD student, with no collapse, and give our main model, M3OPD-Reasoner-9B. MOPD and MixRL can therefore work as consecutive stages that get more out of the same data. We release all data, the training code, and the checkpoints of every stage.

papers.title: TPHC: Improving Hyper-Connections with Tensor-Parallel Grouped Updates
papers.brief: TPHC将张量并行分片与多残差流结合，为各分片输入不同的流混合，并保留分片输出供差异化写回；不增加注意力或前馈子层的参数与计算量。
papers.tldr: 通过张量并行分组读写增强残差流独立性，以较小训练开销改善模型表现。
papers.what_it_is: TPHC将张量并行分片与多残差流结合，为各分片输入不同的流混合，并保留分片输出供差异化写回；不增加注意力或前馈子层的参数与计算量。
key_points: TPHC按张量并行分片独立混合输入、分组写回
8B模型四流训练比mHC慢9%，扩至十六流再慢19%
1.1B模型损失降0.7—1.0%，零样本准确率升0.3—0.7个百分点
papers.why_notable: 它针对多残差流更新趋同的瓶颈，将张量并行用于提升更新表达力，为扩大残差流数量提供了开销可控且有实测收益的路径。
papers.abstract: Hyper-Connections (HC) expand the residual stream of a Transformer into $N$ parallel streams, and manifold-constrained HC (mHC) stabilizes them at scale. However, mHC benefits little from more than four streams, partly because each sublayer writes a single output to all streams, limiting how differently they can be updated. In this work, we propose TPHC, which integrates tensor-parallel (TP) shards with HC streams to promote greater independence across streams. Specifically, we route a separate mixture of the residual streams to each TP shard and keep the individual shard outputs separate during write-back, so each stream can receive a different mixture of those outputs. This design makes the residual-stream updates more expressive without adding parameters or FLOPs to the attention or FFN sublayers. With native support for stream sharding under TP, TPHC requires only 9% more training time than mHC on an 8B model when both use four streams. Increasing the number of streams from four to sixteen raises its training time by only 19%. On a 1.1B model trained on 100B tokens, TPHC reduces validation loss by 0.7-1.0% and raises average zero-shot accuracy across six commonsense reasoning benchmarks by 0.3-0.7 percentage points relative to mHC at matched stream counts $N\in\{4,8,16\}$. Our code is available at https://github.com/wuyou2002/TPHC.

papers.brief: 研究结合参考代码分析与四十份随机抽样技术报告，核查架构继承、创新消融及复现信息披露，并提出七条发布报告规范，在两份报告上试用。

papers.what_it_is: 研究结合参考代码分析与四十份随机抽样技术报告，核查架构继承、创新消融及复现信息披露，并提出七条发布报告规范，在两份报告上试用。
