73项架构或训练创新主张中，仅19项有受控消融
40份报告中，仅1份同时披露数据配比、词元量与算力
papers.why_notable: 把大模型创新叙事转化为可核查的证据问题，为评估技术报告可信度提供量化依据，也为发布规范提供具体改进方向。
papers.abstract: In 2025 alone, 48 new large language model (LLM) architectures were added to the Hugging Face transformers library, and many of them arrive with a technical report that presents the model as new. What is actually new in these models, and is it tested? We put this question to LLM technical reports. We look at three things: what the reference code shows about how new open-weight architectures differ from earlier ones; what 40 randomly sampled technical reports claim as new and whether they support it with ablation studies; and what they disclose for reproducibility and transparency. In the library, 39 of the 48 architectures added in 2025 take at least two of their three core blocks from another model, most often Llama, although part of this reflects how the library writes code. In the reports, 19 of 73 architectural or training novelty claims come with a controlled with/without comparison; 4 of 40 reports state more than one training run; 8 rerun the models they compare against under one setup; and 1 discloses data mixture, token count, and compute together. We also looked for known components given new names: none of five candidate cases hid its origin, though we did not study model names. We propose seven reporting rules for LLM release reports and apply them to two reports. We do not judge model quality, and an untested claim may still be true.

papers.title: Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark
papers.brief: 研究用简单单目位姿估计器检验SPEED+仿真到真实的差距，通过骨干适配与光度增强的交叉实验，比较两种真实光照域的误差及置信覆盖率。
papers.tldr: 航天器位姿估计在真实光照下严重过度自信，迁移收益取决于适配方向。
papers.what_it_is: 研究用简单单目位姿估计器检验SPEED+仿真到真实的差距，通过骨干适配与光度增强的交叉实验，比较两种真实光照域的误差及置信覆盖率。
key_points: 合成域90%共形覆盖率，真实域降至9–38%
适配骨干末阶段，63–83%额外合成收益迁移到真实域
骨干适配后，光度增强使lightbox误差从1.17降至0.99弧度
papers.why_notable: 揭示仿真器光照失配不仅损害精度，还会使置信校准失效；骨干适配与增强效果的差异，为航天视觉迁移提供了具体依据。
papers.abstract: Vision-based navigation systems for orbit must be trained almost entirely on synthetic imagery, because real labelled images of a given spacecraft in flight rarely exist. Benchmarks like SPEED+ are built for that situation: the training set comes from a simulator, and the test sets are real images of a satellite mockup under two kinds of lighting. That simulator approximates how light reflects off mylar and aluminium, and like every scientific simulator it is misspecified. Its error is radiometric, since it misses the specular highlights, hard shadows and sensor saturation common in real images. We probe the resulting synthetic-to-real gap, the central risk for such systems, with a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator. In a 2x2 study of backbone adaptation and photometric augmentation, trained on synthetic images and tested on both real hardware-in-the-loop domains, we find three things. (1) The model does not know it is failing: regions conformally calibrated to 90% on synthetic data cover only 9-15% of rotation errors on sunlamp and 21-38% on lightbox, so a wrong pose carries the confidence of a correct one. (2) Transfer is asymmetric: scaling data and features improved synthetic rotation error from 1.65 to 1.03 rad but moved the harshly lit sunlamp domain by only 0.05 rad, under twice its seed s.d., whereas adapting the backbone's last stage carried 63-83% of its extra synthetic gain to both real domains. (3) Once the backbone adapts, augmentation helps only in the direction it models: our photometric stack improved the diffusely lit lightbox domain from 1.17 to 0.99 rad on every seed but moved sunlamp no more than seed-to-seed variation, while with the backbone frozen it helped sunlamp more. Every post-review experiment was pre-registered, and the code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record are at https://github.com/lokindoo/spacecraft-pose-estimation.

papers.title: MInfoVisQA: A Multilingual Benchmark for Information-Rich Visual Question Answering
papers.brief: 构建覆盖24种语言的信息密集型视觉问答基准，将数值结构与文本分离，并同步翻译图中标签。通过语言对齐与跨语言问答两种设置，检验模型理解的一致性。
papers.tldr: 多语言视觉问答评测揭示，平均准确率掩盖了模型跨语言理解的稳定性差距。
papers.what_it_is: 构建覆盖24种语言的信息密集型视觉问答基准，将数值结构与文本分离，并同步翻译图中标签。通过语言对齐与跨语言问答两种设置，检验模型理解的一致性。
key_points: 128个种子实例生成8,960种问答配置。
LQA均分同为80.4%的模型，语言间极差达7.8与20.3个百分点。
XQA固定英语提问时，25个模型在非英语图像上均降分。
papers.why_notable: 以结构一致、语言不同的视觉材料控制变量，揭示均分之外的鲁棒性差异，为多语言多模态模型评测提供更细粒度依据。
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel in vision-language tasks; yet, whether they maintain consistent understanding of information-rich visuals (InfoVis) when the surface language changes remains unclear. To quantify this capability, we introduce MInfoVisQA, a parallel benchmark with 8,960 QA configurations derived from 128 seed instances across 24 languages. We construct seed-matched, language-parallel visuals and QA pairs by disentangling numerical-structural data from text and programmatically synchronizing translated labels. We evaluate 25 MLLMs under two settings: Language-Aligned QA (LQA, matching visual-text languages) and Cross-Language QA (XQA, fixed QA language with varying visual languages). The results show that aggregate accuracy masks substantial robustness gaps: two models with comparable mean LQA accuracy (80.4\%) exhibit performance spreads of 7.8 and 20.3 percentage points across languages. Moreover, all 25 models score lower with non-English visuals under fixed English QA, underscoring the need for cross-language sensitivity metrics.
papers.organization: Mohamed Bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

papers.title: ReflectScene:MLLM-Guided Closed-Loop Diffusion for 3D Indoor Scene Generation
papers.brief: 提出多模态大模型引导的闭环扩散框架，以分层先验结合多视角证据理解场景，将纠错评估蒸馏为轻量奖励预测器，再把对象级修正融入去噪轨迹。
papers.tldr: 将多模态语义反馈融入扩散去噪闭环，修正三维室内布局并保持场景一致性。
papers.what_it_is: 提出多模态大模型引导的闭环扩散框架，以分层先验结合多视角证据理解场景，将纠错评估蒸馏为轻量奖励预测器，再把对象级修正融入去噪轨迹。
key_points: 分层先验场景理解：冻结MLLM对齐布局与多视角证据
语义奖励评估：轻量Reward Predictor筛选候选修正
轨迹一致扩散：瞬时条件与持续干净估计投影保留非目标布局
papers.why_notable: 把语义纠错从生成后的独立步骤移入去噪过程，减少修正对布局的扰动；在3D-FRONT上改善功能一致性与语义对齐。
papers.abstract: Text-conditioned 3D indoor scene generation requires layouts satisfying geometric, functional, and semantic constraints. However, existing diffusion methods rely primarily on static textual conditions, limiting their ability to assess evolving scenes and translate semantic discrepancies into executable object-level corrections. MLLM-based post-hoc refinement provides semantic feedback but remains decoupled from denoising, potentially disrupting scene coherence.We propose ReflectScene, an MLLM-guided closed-loop diffusion framework. First, we introduce Hierarchical Prior-Grounded Scene Understanding that aligns structured layouts with multi-view visual evidence, to interpret object-specific context and scene global semantics via a frozen multi-modal large language model (MLLM). Second, we propose MLLM-Guided Semantic Reward Evaluation to distill MLLM's diagnoses and assessments on possible candidate corrections into a lightweight Reward Predictor, enabling correction decision making with reduced computation burden. Finally, Decision-Conditioned Trajectory-Consistent Diffusion is proposed to integrate selected corrections through transient conditioning and persistent clean-estimate projection, correcting object layout in the generated scene while preserving non-target arrangements throughout denoising.Experiments on 3D-FRONT demonstrate improved functional consistency and semantic alignment while maintaining competitive generation quality and diversity.

papers.title: RePlan-VLA: Progress-Aware Replanning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.brief: 提出与具体VLA策略无关的执行框架，通过监测机器人运动评估任务进度，并依据实际结果调整后续计划；保留原策略，无需额外微调。
papers.tldr: 通过监测执行进度与动态重规划，让短程机器人策略可靠完成长程任务。
papers.what_it_is: 提出与具体VLA策略无关的执行框架，通过监测机器人运动评估任务进度，并依据实际结果调整后续计划；保留原策略，无需额外微调。
key_points: RePlan-VLA监测运动进度，自适应修订后续计划
RoboCasa365、CALVIN成功率提升21.9%、10.4%
在Franka Research 3机器人上验证真实部署
papers.why_notable: 将长程规划与执行监控从底层动作策略中解耦，无需微调即可提升任务成功率，为复用现有VLA能力提供实用路径。
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet their performance often degrades on long-horizon tasks that require multiple interdependent manipulations. Instead of burdening the VLA policies with long-horizon reasoning, memory, action generation, progress tracking, and error recovery, we argue for leveraging their short-horizon manipulation capabilities within an execution-aware framework. To this end, we introduce \textnormal{\textbf{RePlan-VLA}}, a VLA-agnostic framework that translates a VLA's short-horizon capabilities into reliable long-horizon execution. RePlan-VLA explicitly monitors the robot's motion for progress evaluation, and adaptively revises the future plan based on observed outcomes. We preserve the underlying VLA policy entirely, requiring no additional fine-tuning. Experiments on RoboCasa365 and CALVIN benchmarks show an improvement of 21.9% and 10.4% in success rate over the next strongest baseline. We also validate our approach for real-world deployment on a Franka Research 3 robot.

papers.title: TOGBench: Benchmarking and Improving Tiny-Object Generation Fidelity in Aerial Imagery
papers.brief: 提出TOGBench，针对航拍图像中仅占少量像素的目标开展定量、物体级评估；另以训练期和推理期两种简单技术，提升布局到图像生成器的微小目标保真度。
papers.tldr: 以物体级基准衡量航拍微小目标生成保真度，并改进布局到图像生成。
papers.what_it_is: 提出TOGBench，针对航拍图像中仅占少量像素的目标开展定量、物体级评估；另以训练期和推理期两种简单技术，提升布局到图像生成器的微小目标保真度。
key_points: TOGBench定量评估物体级微小目标生成保真度
评估对象包括仅占少量像素的车辆、船舶与飞机
两种训练期与推理期技术提升布局到图像生成表现
papers.why_notable: 将生成评估从提示词遵循和人类偏好拓展到微小目标保真度，为航拍生成模型提供更贴近物体细节的评测与改进方向。
papers.abstract: Advances in deep generative models now enable the synthesis of realistic imagery. However, aerial imagery is dominated by tiny objects, such as vehicles, ships, and aircraft, which occupy only a few pixels owing to the overhead, wide-area nature of aerial imaging. Existing generative models struggle substantially more with tiny objects than with larger ones. This limitation has been overlooked, as prior work on generative evaluation emphasizes prompt following or human preference rather than whether small objects are rendered faithfully. To address this gap, we introduce TOGBench, a quantitative, object-level benchmark for evaluating tiny-object generation fidelity in aerial imagery. We further propose two simple train-/inference-time techniques that improve the ability of layout-to-image generators to render small objects, raising their performance on TOGBench.

papers.title: A System 1 Decision Model for Medical Multiple-Choice Questions Built on Frozen Language Models
papers.brief: 研究用冻结语言模型编码题目与选项，仅训练两个投影头和温度参数，以共享空间中的距离单次选答。再通过单词总结提示与对比学习改善医学题表现。
papers.tldr: 冻结语言模型加轻量投影头可快速回答医学选择题，但准确率仍明显受限。
papers.what_it_is: 研究用冻结语言模型编码题目与选项，仅训练两个投影头和温度参数，以共享空间中的距离单次选答。再通过单词总结提示与对比学习改善医学题表现。
key_points: 对比损失结合批内负例、困难负例与重复答案掩码
单词总结提示配合较低学习率，小模型准确率达42.5%
Qwen3-8B三种子准确率46.0%±0.2
papers.why_notable: 提供了低训练成本、快速选答的医学问答基线，也量化了其性能边界：仍落后于已报告的医学模型，且验证集收益高于测试集。
papers.abstract: A System 1 model answers a multiple-choice question in a single pass. A frozen language model turns the question and each option into vectors, two small, trained heads place them in a shared space, and the closest option wins. The design has been shown on agent decisions, but we are not aware of a study of how far it goes on exam questions that need medical knowledge, where the right option is often no more similar to the question than the wrong ones. We rebuilt the recipe from scratch for MedMCQA and trained only two projection heads and one temperature on top of frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B, Granite-4.2-3B and Qwen3-8B, using a contrastive loss with in-batch and hard negatives and a mask for repeated answers. With plain last-token vectors, both small encoders answer about one question in three correctly (33.1% and 33.0% on 3,842 held-out questions, where chance is 25.0%). Writing each text inside a one-word-summary prompt and lowering the learning rate of the heads raised this to 41.7% and 42.5% for the two small encoders and to 46.0% +-0.2 (three seeds) for Qwen3-8B. Shuffling the questions against the options returns accuracy to chance, so the heads do use the question. Flan-PaLM and Med-PaLM 2 report 57.6% and 72.3% on MedMCQA under a different protocol, so ours is a cheap, fast baseline and not a competitive system. We also say what our evidence cannot show: validation gains were about 1.7 to 2 times the test gains, and we could not separate the effect of reading several encoder layers from the other changes.

papers.title: Learning Martial Arts Motion Skills for Animating Opponents in VR Sparring Games
papers.brief: 通过动作捕捉与强化学习训练武术动作技能，并适配定向攻击和威胁规避；用户评估与VR对练原型验证了其作为虚拟对手动画基础的可行性。
papers.tldr: 通过动作捕捉与强化学习训练武术动作技能，并适配定向攻击和威胁规避；用户评估与VR对练原型验证了其作为虚拟对手动画基础的可行性。
papers.abstract: Animating virtual opponents is an important yet challenging task in game development. In martial arts games, opponent motions must not only be physically plausible but also exhibit appropriate technique, timing, transitions, and target-directed intent. Traditional game animations often rely on handcrafted clips, state machine transitions, and procedural adjustments, which can be labor-intensive and may limit the behavioral diversity of non-player characters. This paper presents a martial arts motion skills learning framework for character animation in virtual sparring games. Inspired by Tang Soo Do, we collected a martial arts motion capture dataset containing isolated attacking and defending techniques, technique combinations and transitions, and contextual sparring variations. We first pretrained a reusable repertoire of martial arts motion skills from the captured data using reinforcement learning (RL) with adversarial style rewards, and then adapted these skills with task-specific rewards for target-directed striking and threat-aware evasion. We evaluated the motions generated by the learned policy through a user study, in which participants assessed their physical plausibility, smoothness, and martial arts form. To demonstrate their applicability to interactive gameplay, we developed a VR sparring prototype for Meta Quest headsets. The prototype combines policy-generated motion clips with lightweight state-based control to support interactive opponent behavior. Together, these findings support the feasibility of using a learned martial arts skill repertoire as a motion foundation for animating opponents in VR sparring games.

papers.title: Evidence-Based Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Language Models
papers.brief: 提出基于检索证据效用的信用分配方法，为搜索增强语言模型提供训练信号；在七项问答基准上提升准确率，并展现多跳问答迁移能力。
papers.tldr: 提出基于检索证据效用的信用分配方法，为搜索增强语言模型提供训练信号；在七项问答基准上提升准确率，并展现多跳问答迁移能力。
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning from terminal answer rewards enables search-augmented language models to interleave reasoning and retrieval without step-level annotations, yet outcome supervision assigns identical credit to every search in a trajectory regardless of whether it retrieved useful information. This limitation is especially severe when all sampled rollouts for a question fail, collapsing group-centered outcome advantages to zero even when trajectories gather markedly different evidence. We present Evidence-based Credit Assignment (ECA), which augments terminal outcome rewards with a training-only auxiliary signal measuring how retrieved documents improve the likelihood of a reference answer. Rather than scoring the full dialogue prefix, ECA queries a frozen snapshot of the current policy under an evidence-only prompt containing solely the question and the deduplicated documents observed so far, isolating the utility of retrieved passages from surface variations in generated thoughts or search queries. Within this framework, we compare two return formulations, ECA-Step (which accumulates step-clipped potential increments) and ECA-Horizon (which preserves the telescoping horizon gain in potential), paired with cross-fold group normalization, novelty gating, and search-local token assignment. Across seven Search QA benchmarks, ECA-Horizon improves strict macro exact match over an outcome-only GRPO baseline by 1.03 and 4.80 percentage points on Qwen2.5-3B- and 7B-Instruct, respectively, outperforming both RLOO and GiGPO. Zero-shot evaluation on MultiHop-RAG further demonstrates strong transfer to multi-hop inference queries.

papers.title: Metrics-in-the-Loop: Complexity Feedback Reshapes Agent-Written Code
papers.brief: 在编码智能体运行中注入复杂度与测试覆盖反馈，促使其及时重构或补测。跨三个长程基准、四个模型的实验显示，复杂度反馈显著减少复杂度集中，且不损害正确性。
papers.tldr: 在编码智能体运行中注入复杂度与测试覆盖反馈，促使其及时重构或补测。跨三个长程基准、四个模型的实验显示，复杂度反馈显著减少复杂度集中，且不损害正确性。
papers.abstract: Coding agents now write whole codebases in long autonomous runs, guided mainly by whether their tests pass. Yet passing tests alone does not reveal accumulating complexity or gaps in test coverage, which then persist as agents extend their own code. We introduce metrics-in-the-loop, an inference-time intervention that gives agents in-flight feedback: cheap, automatically computed code metrics injected into the agent's context during the trajectory. After each code-changing agent turn, we insert short feedback messages naming changed functions whose cyclomatic complexity exceeds a limit (complexity feedback) or changed lines that are skipped by tests (coverage feedback), giving the agent the opportunity to refactor code or strengthen tests before continuing. We run extensive experiments and ablations comparing several interventions across three long-horizon coding benchmarks and four strong models. We find that complexity feedback significantly reduces erosion, a measure of complexity concentration of code, without affecting held-out correctness of the code. Broadly, our experiments investigate a practical form of agent "re-railing", where timely, actionable measurements redirect agents before weaknesses become the foundation they keep building on. As agents scale to codebases with millions of lines, such interventions become critical to sustaining effective development and long-term code maintainability.

papers.title: Continual Tool-Space Extension Learning for Multimodal Agents
papers.brief: COTEX以适配器级训练扩展智能体工具空间，区分触发调用与选择工具的参数方向，并用正交约束保护旧工具选择；另将专业模型标注转为验证过的调用轨迹。
papers.tldr: 通过正交约束适配器，让多模态智能体持续接入专业视觉工具并保留旧能力。
papers.what_it_is: COTEX以适配器级训练扩展智能体工具空间，区分触发调用与选择工具的参数方向，并用正交约束保护旧工具选择；另将专业模型标注转为验证过的调用轨迹。
key_points: COTEX分离触发工具调用与选择工具的参数方向
新工具适配器施加正交约束，保护已有工具选择
2种智能体、3种工具在10项基准提升，旧工具最多降0.3分
papers.why_notable: 将专业视觉模型接入已训练智能体，不必全面重训；实验显示扩展工具能力的同时可保持旧工具表现，为持续扩展提供可行路径。
papers.abstract: Multimodal agents largely rely on generic tools such as cropping, search, and code execution, leaving specialist vision models outside their tool space. However, bringing such a model into an already trained agent is not straightforward. The challenge is to learn each new tool efficiently while retaining the ability to use existing ones. This work proposes COTEX, continual tool-space extension learning, that adds new tools at efficient adapter-level cost. COTEX locates two sets of parameter directions; one triggers a tool call and thereby opens a multi-turn reasoning trajectory, while the other determines which tool is chosen. The adapter of a new tool is restricted to the calling directions that leave earlier tool choices unaffected by orthogonal constraint. We further introduce a protocol that converts specialist models' existing task-specific annotations into verified tool-use trajectories. Experiments on two representative agents and three specialist tools show gains on ten vision-language benchmarks, with at most a 0.3-point drop on existing tools.

papers.title: Interpreting Timestamp Permutations in Dynamic Link Prediction
papers.brief: 研究用交叉诊断拆分时间戳置乱对训练与评估历史的影响。实验发现性能差距主要来自训练条件，而非历史变化，说明单一置乱差距不足以判定模型是否利用时序。
papers.tldr: 研究用交叉诊断拆分时间戳置乱对训练与评估历史的影响。实验发现性能差距主要来自训练条件，而非历史变化，说明单一置乱差距不足以判定模型是否利用时序。
papers.abstract: Timestamp permutations are used to test whether dynamic link predictors exploit temporal information, but a performance gap can reflect changes in training, evaluation history, or both. We separate these effects with a crossed diagnostic and measure input exposure: whether altered histories actually change the predictor's inputs. On MOOC, TCL trained with binary cross-entropy gains approximately eight pairwise-accuracy points from original-chronology training under either evaluation history, while changing history at fixed weights gives only 0.03 points. The small history contrast reflects unchanged inputs for 68.37% of queries, stable rankings for most others, and cancellation of gains and losses. Under original evaluation history, suppressing explicit time encoding reduces the training contrast from 8.03 to 3.64 points, a paired reduction of 4.39 points (95% interval [3.68, 5.09]) across six seeds. DyGFormer shows corresponding training and history contrasts of 22.34 and 0.38 points across two seeds, despite greater exposure. Partial history permutations further separate nominal intervention strength, input changes, and aggregate accuracy. These comparisons turn a single permutation gap into interpretable statements about training conditions and model responses, while leaving the internal mechanisms of temporal learning open.

papers.title: Beyond Replacement: Levenshtein Editing for Diffusion Language Models
papers.brief: LED是扩散语言模型的后训练框架，将替换式修订扩展为插入、删除和替换。它通过最长公共子序列对齐构造编辑监督，并用多阶段训练学习纠正先前错误。
papers.tldr: 让扩散语言模型通过插入、删除与替换自我纠错，兼顾生成质量与效率
papers.what_it_is: LED是扩散语言模型的后训练框架，将替换式修订扩展为插入、删除和替换。它通过最长公共子序列对齐构造编辑监督，并用多阶段训练学习纠正先前错误。
key_points: 最长公共子序列对齐自动生成编辑标签，无需人工标注
16B模型十二项均分54.86→57.10，单次前向产出亦增加
无置信度引导时均分27.52→47.19，大k下多样性更优
papers.why_notable: 把纠错从逐词替换扩展到序列结构修订，更适合处理漏词与冗余词；结果也显示，无置信度引导的扩散生成仍有质量和多样性潜力。
papers.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a flexible alternative to autoregressive models, enabling any-order infilling. While most existing decoding methods treat decoded tokens as fixed, some recent models allow previously decoded tokens to be revised only by replacing them with alternative tokens, a paradigm we refer to as replacement-only editing (ROE). Although ROE can correct individual tokens, it is inefficient for sequence shifts caused by missing or extra tokens and struggles when errors occur across many positions. To address these limitations, we propose LED (Levenshtein Editing for Diffusion Language Models), a post-training framework that extends ROE with insertion and deletion, enabling Levenshtein-style refinement of generated sequences. It uses two training designs. First, it reconstructs edit supervision on the fly during supervised fine-tuning using longest-common-subsequence alignment, enabling insertion and deletion learning without manually annotated labels. Second, it adopts multi-stage training, where the state from one stage becomes the input to the next, exposing the model to its earlier errors and enabling it to correct them. When applied to the 16B-parameter LLaDA2.1-Mini Base, LED raises the average score across twelve benchmarks from 54.86 to 57.10 under confidence-guided decoding while increasing tokens per forward from 6.14 to 7.05, whereas under confidence-free decoding it raises the average score from 27.52 to 47.19. We further show that LED achieves higher pass@k at large k than thresholded decoding without editing, demonstrating improved generation diversity and revealing the diversity potential of DLMs without confidence guidance. LED also improves robustness to large block sizes, raising the average score from 36.97 to 51.34 at block size 128. Together, these results suggest that LED supports more robust self-correction in DLMs.

papers.title: Modeling LLM Reasoning Dynamics with Structural Representations
papers.brief: 用文本、局部事件和活动跨度建模大模型推理动态，多数评测组的后续预测得到改善；有限过程实验中保持最优动作不变，平均推理CPU耗时降低77.7%。
papers.tldr: 用文本、局部事件和活动跨度建模大模型推理动态，多数评测组的后续预测得到改善；有限过程实验中保持最优动作不变，平均推理CPU耗时降低77.7%。
papers.abstract: Language-model reasoning alternates between sustained activities and local operations. We study how this temporal structure predicts continuation and the computation needed to analyze it. T/E/S combines text, local events, and spans of activity. Across reasoning and information-seeking tasks, events and spans improve next-outcome prediction in 70 of 76 evaluation groups for a Transformer and 74 of 76 for Qwen with LoRA. Span duration and preceding events are associated with transitions, and retaining event history across span boundaries improves prediction. We formulate budget-allocation counting and action-conditional continuation queries, prove counting hardness under explicit encodings, and derive conditions for affordable decision certification. In finite-process experiments, bounds that cancel shared continuation mass recover the same optimal actions as full dynamic programming while reducing mean inference CPU time by 77.7%. On 71 held-out HotpotQA and MuSiQue questions, a compact structural observer improves prediction of whether a fixed inference procedure finishes within a CPU allowance: Brier loss falls from 0.0836 to 0.0756. An annotation audit identifies substantial errors in that observer, separating this computational result from semantic validation of its features.

papers.title: Reliability is a user-specific property of large language models
papers.brief: 提出按特定用户与使用条件评估大模型可靠性，区分故障发现与可靠性测试，并给出六项研究路线；主张以注明适用条件和不确定性的运行声明补充能力评分，整体验证尚待开展。
papers.tldr: 提出按特定用户与使用条件评估大模型可靠性，区分故障发现与可靠性测试，并给出六项研究路线；主张以注明适用条件和不确定性的运行声明补充能力评分，整体验证尚待开展。
papers.abstract: Public benchmarks support comparisons of large language model (LLM) capabilities, yet users can experience the same highly ranked model differently. Drawing on traditional software reliability, we argue that the reliability of an LLM service should be assessed for specified users and conditions of use. This requires more than a capability score: evaluation evidence must support a claim about failure during future operation. We distinguish testing to discover faults from testing to assess reliability and identify ten modelling considerations behind such claims. We propose a six-workstream research roadmap linking claim specification, dynamic operational profiles, graded outcomes and noisy judgements, local probabilistic robustness, interaction dependence, and statistical inference with reassessment. Local probabilistic robustness addresses the behavioural variation hidden when different concrete inputs are treated as the same task. Published findings and an illustrative customer-support example motivate the roadmap; its integrated validation remains an open research task. Reliability claims complement, but do not replace, separate safety and security arguments. Capability scores should therefore be complemented by versioned operational claims that state whose requirements are covered, under which conditions, and with what uncertainty.

papers.title: Toward Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Neural AC Power Flow
papers.brief: 研究三类图神经网络从小电网到未见大电网的零样本迁移，发现物理约束有效、边属性扰动最高改善54.6%，但多电网训练仍不及目标电网训练。
papers.tldr: 研究三类图神经网络从小电网到未见大电网的零样本迁移，发现物理约束有效、边属性扰动最高改善54.6%，但多电网训练仍不及目标电网训练。
papers.abstract: Growing uncertainty in power system operations from renewables integration, extreme weather, and data center loads challenges the reliability of traditional power flow solvers at scale. Machine learning-based proxies are a potentially promising alternative, but the prohibitive cost of generating training data for large grids makes out-of-distribution generalization a key capability for deployment; currently, models trained on small grids lack that capability. In this work, we systematically evaluate how physics-informed losses, multi-grid training, and perturbation-based data augmentation improve the zero-shot transfer of three graph neural network-based power flow models from smaller systems to a larger, unseen 500-bus system. We find that (1) physics-informed losses improve transfer relative to purely supervised objectives; (2) multi-grid training on smaller systems matches the best single grid but does not close the gap to target-grid training; (3) perturbation-based augmentation on edge attributes improves transfer by up to 54.6%; and (4) random line/generator dropout does not consistently improve performance.

papers.title: AdaS-ViT: Test-Time Adaptive Routing for Spiking Vision Transformers with Ultra-High Energy Efficiency
papers.brief: 提出测试时自适应路由的脉冲视觉Transformer，联合调节时空与通道放电；在ImageNet上保持竞争力，每图耗能仅1.02至2.45毫焦。
papers.tldr: 提出测试时自适应路由的脉冲视觉Transformer，联合调节时空与通道放电；在ImageNet上保持竞争力，每图耗能仅1.02至2.45毫焦。
papers.abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) promise event-driven and energy-efficient vision, yet existing spiking vision transformers (S-ViTs) largely confine spiking tokens to fixed and uniform firing schemes along the temporal, spatial and channel dimensions, whereas suppressing the computational redundancy thus incurred calls for adaptive firing mechanisms that operate jointly across all three axes at test time. To this end, we propose the Adaptive Efficient Integrate-and-Fire (AdaE-IF) model, which consults the attention score of each spiking token and routes salient regions to fine-grained firing patterns while assigning energy-frugal coarse patterns to the remaining regions. Building on AdaE-IF, we further introduce Spiking Gated Self-Attention (S-GSA) and Spiking Local-Gated Unit (S-LGU), which enforce selective spike emission at token and channel granularity. We integrate the aforementioned mechanisms and modules into AdaS-ViT, a test-time adaptive-routing architecture trained with a progressive spatio-temporal curriculum that stabilizes the co-adaptation of firing precision and routing masks. Extensive experiments across benchmarks spanning diverse data scales and modalities demonstrate that AdaS-ViT consistently achieves highly competitive performance. Notably, on ImageNet-1k it consumes only 1.02 to 2.45 millijoules per image and attains an accuracy-per-energy ratio of 32$\times$ to 72$\times$, operating in an economical inference regime and thereby pushing the energy-efficiency boundary further.

papers.title: NarrowSpec: Draft Hidden Width Need Not Match the Target in Speculative Decoding
papers.brief: 将推测解码草稿模型的隐藏宽度减至一半或四分之一，基本保持接受率；跨模型与硬件测试中，端到端解码最高加速1.44倍，大批量下仍有收益。
papers.tldr: 将推测解码草稿模型的隐藏宽度减至一半或四分之一，基本保持接受率；跨模型与硬件测试中，端到端解码最高加速1.44倍，大批量下仍有收益。
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding is widely used to speed up generation in large language models (LLMs), with a small draft model proposing tokens that one forward pass of the target model verifies. Draft models that read the target's hidden states, such as DFlash and EAGLE-3, typically inherit the target's hidden width. We show that the draft's whole residual stream can run at half or a quarter of that width while largely preserving acceptance. For DFlash, which borrows the target's vocabulary projection, the trained output adapter folds into it, giving one narrower projection with logits unchanged up to floating-point rounding. We test two drafter families, DFlash and EAGLE-3, on two targets, Qwen3-8B (NVFP4) and GPT-OSS-20B (MXFP4), in SGLang on a B200 and a DGX Spark (GB10). At batch size 1 and temperature 0, narrowing the draft to half or a quarter width speeds up end-to-end decoding by 1.06-1.12x on B200 and 1.13-1.44x on GB10. The speedup holds at larger batch sizes. From batch 32 to the largest batch each GPU fits, narrowing reaches up to 1.21x on both GPUs, and no narrow draft is slower than full width.

papers.title: Sightline: Long-Window Speculative Decoding for Fast SVG Generation
papers.brief: Sightline结合长验证窗口与宽草稿树，无损加速SVG生成；在多模型、多基准上领先其他无损解码器，表明矢量图生成适合更长的推测窗口。
papers.tldr: Sightline结合长验证窗口与宽草稿树，无损加速SVG生成；在多模型、多基准上领先其他无损解码器，表明矢量图生成适合更长的推测窗口。
papers.abstract: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) generation models write a graphic as code with one forward pass per token, so drawing is slow. Speculative decoding speeds them up losslessly, and block drafters guess many tokens per pass. On SVG, many of their rounds accept the whole draft and end only at the verification window. We find that their misses are rare and clumped, and that they stay accurate far deeper into a block than on natural language. A run-length identity and three propositions show that a longer window pays once the candidates are wide, up to the drafter's horizon. We propose Sightline, which pairs a window as long as the drafter's horizon with a draft tree wide enough to fill it. Experiments cover text-to-SVG and image-to-SVG with three models on six benchmarks from MMSVG, MMSVG-2M and SArena. In every setting, Sightline is the fastest of the compared lossless decoders. On SArena, it stays the fastest when every decoder shares one loop control. It also leads in almost every setting of six models from four other families, which write SVG code, compressed SVG tokens or Lottie JSON. Analyses trace the lead to rounds that shorter windows cut off, both in loop-free content and in loops. Speculative decoding also saves time for choosing samples by rendering, which beats choosing by likelihood. These results suggest that speculative decoding on vector graphics should verify as far as the drafter sees. Code and data are available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/Sightline.

papers.title: Geometry-bridge flow matching for blind rigid-motion correction in head cone-beam CT
papers.brief: 提出几何桥流匹配先验，联合校正头部锥束CT刚体运动与重建图像；模拟测试达领先水平，较线性训练提升PSNR并降低重投影误差。
papers.tldr: 提出几何桥流匹配先验，联合校正头部锥束CT刚体运动与重建图像；模拟测试达领先水平，较线性训练提升PSNR并降低重投影误差。
papers.abstract: Rigid motion of a patient head during head cone-beam CT (CBCT) scan can degrade image quality and complicate recovery of accurate anatomical structures from the measured projections. We present a 3D flow-matching prior approach that learns the image changes induced by motion. Its geometry-bridge connects motion-corrupted and motion-free Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstructed images of the same source volume through progressively reduced simulated motion. The forward projector's geometry derivative supplies analytic velocity targets along this path. A plug-and-play loop encompasses the learned image updates together with spline-based pose estimation, conjugate-gradient data consistency, and image total-variation regularization. Both the refined image volume and the FDK reconstructed image volume at the estimated poses are evaluated. On simulated 360-view scans from 30 held-out CQ500 patients with nominal per-component motion amplitudes within 10 mm / 10 degrees, the framework achieved state-of-the-art image reconstruction quality and motion accuracy in comparison with other methos such as learned autofocus and diffusion-based joint reconstruction. Mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) reached 37.1 dB and mean detector-plane reprojection error (RPE) was 0.27 mm. With matched endpoints at the inference settings, the geometry bridge improved PSNR by 1.6 dB and reduced RPE by 33% relative to image-linear training. With 50 prior updates and coarse-to-fine motion estimation, total processing time averaged 9.1 minutes per patient on an RTX A6000.
